mapper.select: SELECT M.CATEGORY , M.CATEGORY_NAME , D.CODE , D.CODE_NAME FROM CODE_MST M INNER JOIN CODE_DTL D ON M.CATEGORY = D.CATEGORY AND M.COMPANY_CODE = D.COMPANY_CODE WHERE M.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND M.CATEGORY = #{searchText} AND D.DELETE_YN = 'N' ORDER BY D.SORT_NO

SELECT M.CATEGORY , M.CATEGORY_NAME , D.CODE , D.CODE_NAME FROM CODE_MST M INNER JOIN CODE_DTL D ON M.CATEGORY = D.CATEGORY AND M.COMPANY_CODE = D.COMPANY_CODE WHERE M.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND M.CATEGORY = 'NA'
AND (D.CODE LIKE CONCAT(#{searchText} , '%') OR D.CODE_NAME LIKE CONCAT(#{searchText} , '%'))
AND D.DELETE_YN = 'N' ORDER BY D.SORT_NO

SELECT ITEM_CODE AS CODE , ITEM_NAME AS CODE_NAME , HS_CODE FROM ITEM_MST WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND DELETE_YN = 'N'
AND (ITEM_CODE LIKE CONCAT(#{searchText} , '%') OR ITEM_NAME LIKE CONCAT(#{searchText} , '%'))
ORDER BY ITEM_CODE

SELECT HS_CODE AS CODE , HS_CODE_NAME AS CODE_NAME FROM HS_CODE WHERE DELETE_YN ='N'
AND (HS_CODE LIKE CONCAT(#{searchText} , '%') OR HS_CODE_NAME LIKE CONCAT(#{searchText} , '%'))
ORDER BY HS_CODE

SELECT F.FTA_CODE AS CODE , F.FTA_NAME AS CODE_NAME , F.EFFECT_DATE FROM FTA_MASTER F WHERE F.COMPANY_CODE = 'FRT100' AND F.DELETE_YN = 'N'
AND (F.FTA_CODE LIKE CONCAT(#{searchText} , '%') OR F.FTA_NAME LIKE CONCAT(#{searchText} , '%'))
AND F.EFFECT_DATE <= #{searchEffectDate}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FTA_APPLY_NATION T WHERE T.FTA_CODE = F.FTA_CODE AND T.NATION_CODE = #{searchNation} )
ORDER BY FTA_CODE
